{"markdown":"# Issues Memo — IBM Hosting Services Agreement (Base Terms)

**To:** Deal team 
**From:** In-house counsel (Customer side) 
**Re:** Playbook review — 18 findings across the Base Terms

---

## Executive summary

We have reviewed the Base Terms against our playbook and identified **18 findings: 3 critical, 5 high, 8 medium/low deviations or gaps, and 6 compliant items**. The commercial architecture is workable — there is no exclusivity, no non-compete, no MFN, no minimum commitment and no non-solicit binding us, and New York law is our preferred position — so the negotiation can be focused on a narrow set of risk-allocation clauses.

Three issues are not signable in their current form. First, **indemnification is asymmetric**: IBM covers only third-party IP infringement (capped at 12 months' charges as sole remedy) while we indemnify any Services Recipient claim "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services". Second, **IP ownership defaults against us**: deliverables are Type II Materials owned by IBM or third parties, with only a narrow Enterprise-use licence back and no confirmation that we retain ownership of our Content and data. Third, the **liability regime is inadequate for a hosting vendor**: the floor is $100,000 against our USD 1,000,000 preference, the cap runs on fees "paid" only, IBM excludes all liability for loss of or damage to our records and data despite hosting them, and there are no Excluded Claims carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud or IP infringement.

Secondary but material: there is **no transition assistance, data return or deletion obligation** anywhere in the agreement, and **no insurance clause** — both unusual for a vendor holding our Content and personal data. Termination for convenience is available to us on one month's notice but is conditioned on uncapped early termination charges with no refund of prepaid amounts, and auto-renewal repeats the prior (potentially multi-year) term on a 90-day opt-out window.

---

## Findings

| # | Severity | Rule | Status | Section | Issue in brief |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Critical | INDEMN — Indemnification by Vendor | Deviation | § 8.1 Indemnification by IBM | IBM indemnity limited to third-party IP (12-month credit as sole remedy); our indemnity is open-ended for Services Recipient claims. |
| 2 | Critical | IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data | Deviation | § 5.4 Other Disclaimers | Deliverables default to Type II (IBM-owned); licence back is Enterprise-use only, no modify/sublicense; no Customer data ownership statement. |
| 3 | Critical | LOL-CAP — Limitation of liability | Deviation | § 9.1 IBM's Limitation of Liability | $100,000 floor; "paid" fees basis; IBM excludes liability for loss of our records/data; no Excluded Claims carve-outs. |
| 4 | High | ASSIGN — Assignment and change of control | Deviation | § 14.10 Assignment | Consent restriction binds only us (successor carve-out, no affiliate carve-out); no restriction on IBM assigning, including to competitors. |
| 5 | High | LD — Liquidated damages / penalties | Deviation | § 3.4 Termination for Convenience | Uncapped early termination charges plus unspecified late payment fees (4.2); Section 10 preserves IBM's recovery of charges for Services not rendered due to our breach. |
| 6 | High | LICENSE — Licence grant scope | Deviation | § 12.1 License | Grant is revocable, runs to Customer only (no Affiliates or contractors), and is non-transferable (14.17). |
| 7 | High | T4C — Termination for convenience | Deviation | § 3.4 Termination for Convenience | Our one-month convenience right is acceptable, but is conditioned on uncapped early termination charges with no refund of prepaid charges. |
| 8 | Medium | AUDIT — Audit rights against Customer | Deviation | § 11.3 Suspected Violations | IBM investigation right unlimited in frequency, no advance notice, no cost allocation, no exclusion of access to our systems. |
| 9 | Medium | RENEWAL — Auto-renewal / notice window | Deviation | § 3.2 Renewal | Auto-renewal repeats the prior (possibly multi-year) term; 90-day non-renewal window exceeds our 30-day preference / 60-day fallback. Note 13.1 allows IBM price changes after 12 months on 90 days' notice. |
| 10 | Medium | TRANSITION — Transition assistance and data return | **Missing** | § 3.5 Effect of Termination | Clause addresses only our payment obligations; no transition assistance, data return/export or deletion certification. |
| 11 | Medium | WARRANTY — Performance warranty | Deviation | § 5.1 IBM Representations and Warranties | Reasonable care and skill only; no conformance warranty, no warranty period, no repair/replace/refund; 5.4 puts Materials "AS IS". |
| 12 | Low | INSURANCE — Vendor insurance | **Missing** | § 14.12 Risk of Loss | No insurance clause despite IBM hosting our environment and processing our Content and personal data. |
| 13 | High | EXCLUSIVITY | Compliant | § 14.16 Freedom of Action | No exclusivity or requirements obligation; Freedom of Action confirms we may source hosting elsewhere. |
| 14 | High | NONCOMPETE | Compliant | § 14.16 Freedom of Action | No non-compete or field-of-use restriction; only restraint is 14.11 No Resale. |
| 15 | Medium | GOVLAW | Compliant | § 14.3 Choice of Law | New York law; no arbitration or foreign venue. |
| 16 | Medium | MFN | Compliant | § 4.1 Charges | No most-favoured-nation or price-matching undertaking on us. |
| 17 | Medium | MINCOMMIT | Compliant | § 4.1 Charges | No minimum purchase, take-or-pay or volume cap in the Base Terms; capacity changes at our discretion (11.5). |
| 18 | Medium | NOSOLICIT | Compliant | § 14.8 Personnel | No non-solicitation or no-hire restriction binding us. |

---

## Walk-away items

We should not sign without resolution of the following:

1. **Liability for our data (§ 9.1).** IBM's exclusion of all liability for loss of or damage to our records and data is irreconcilable with its role as host. We require deletion of that exclusion, the cap raised to the greater of **USD 1,000,000 or 12 months' charges**, and Excluded Claims carve-outs for confidentiality, data protection/security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement.
2. **Indemnity symmetry (§ 8.1).** IBM's indemnity must extend beyond IP to breach of law, data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, and our indemnity for Services Recipient claims must be narrowed from "related, directly or indirectly, to the Services".
3. **Ownership of our Content and deliverables (§ 5.4).** Materials must default to **Type I** (Customer-owned), with an express statement that we retain ownership of Content and data.
4. **Exit (§ 3.5).** As a hosting arrangement with no transition, data return or deletion obligation, we cannot accept the current exit position: we require six months' transition assistance, 30-day data return and certified deletion.

---

## Next steps

1. **Issue the redline** covering all 12 deviation/missing items, leading with the four walk-away positions above.
2. **Termination economics (§ 3.4).** Cap early termination charges at **three months' charges**, add pro-rata refund of prepaid charges, and confirm that the capped charge is the only liquidated-damages-type amount payable by us (addressing the Section 10 recovery language and the unspecified late payment fees in 4.2).
3. **Renewal (§ 3.2).** Move to 12-month renewals with a 30-day opt-out; fallback 60 days. Seek a cap on the 13.1 price-change right in the same pass.
4. **Licence and assignment.** Extend the § 12.1 grant to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf, delete "revocable", add successor transferability; in § 14.10 add an affiliate/successor carve-out for us, make consent mutual, and confirm IBM has no change-of-control assignment right.
5. **Warranty and audit.** Add a 90-day conformance warranty with repair/replace/refund and carve the express warranties out of the § 5.4 "AS IS" disclaimer; apply once-per-12-months / 30 days' notice / IBM-cost / no-system-access limits to § 11.3.
6. **Insurance.** Insert a short CGL / E&O / cyber clause with certificates on request following § 14.12.
7. **Diligence before signature.** Review Attachment A and each Service Option Attachment for committed volumes and for the early termination charge formula — the Base Terms are clean on minimum commitments, but the attachments have not yet been reviewed.
8. **Optional.** If § 14.3 is reopened for any reason, add exclusive New York County venue; we would not reopen it otherwise."}
